# KI: Kit Fine Counterfactual Fault Localization & Truthmaker State Fragment Fusion

## Operational Summary
Classical binary logic evaluates claims against entire state spaces, obscuring the exact sub-state responsible for a failure. Em-Cubed implements Kit Fine's Truthmaker Semantics (`ExactTruthmakerClassifier`), classifying states into exact truthmakers ($s \Vdash A$) containing only wholly relevant facts, exact falsemakers ($s \Vdash_f A$), and identifying the minimal counterfactual fault fragment ($s \sqcup t$) causing verification breakdown.
